title: ODNI UAP records - 576UAP0003
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary assessment report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) prepared by the ODNI for the Congressional Intelligence and Armed Services Committees, covering data from 2004 to 2021.

incidents.summary: A UAP incident identified as a large, deflating balloon.
18 incidents involving unusual UAP movement patterns or flight characteristics.
11 documented instances of near misses between pilots and UAP.
